import pprint
from pyspark.sql.types import *
import json
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, explode
from pyspark.sql import DataFrame
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
import pyspark.sql.utils

storage_account: str = mssparkutils.notebook.run('/utils/py_utils_get_storage_account')
path_to_orchestration_file: str = "abfss://odw-config@"+storage_account+"odw-config/Crown Dev Data Dictionaries.xlsx"
print(path_to_orchestration_file)

# ==========================================================
# Compare Excel Dictionary Columns vs Spark Table Columns
# Pipeline Parameter: path_to_orchestration_file
# ==========================================================

import pandas as pd

# -------- Parameters --------
path_to_orchestration_file = mssparkutils.notebook.getArgument(
    "path_to_orchestration_file"
)

sheet_name = "Standardised"          # Excel sheet name
dictionary_table_name = "sb_representation"   # Table Name in Excel
spark_table_name = "odw_standardised_db.sb_applications_representation"

print(f"Excel File      : {path_to_orchestration_file}")
print(f"Sheet Name      : {sheet_name}")
print(f"Dictionary Table: {dictionary_table_name}")
print(f"Spark Table     : {spark_table_name}")

# -------- Read Excel --------
excel_df = pd.read_excel(
    path_to_orchestration_file,
    sheet_name=sheet_name
)

# -------- Get columns from Excel dictionary --------
excel_columns = (
    excel_df[
        excel_df["Table Name"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.lower()
        == dictionary_table_name.lower()
    ]["Attribute Name"]
    .dropna()
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
    .tolist()
)

excel_columns = sorted(list(set(excel_columns)))

# -------- Get columns from Spark table --------
spark_columns = spark.table(
    spark_table_name
).columns

spark_columns = sorted(list(set(spark_columns)))

# -------- Compare --------
excel_set = set(c.lower() for c in excel_columns)
spark_set = set(c.lower() for c in spark_columns)

matched_columns = sorted(excel_set.intersection(spark_set))
missing_in_table = sorted(excel_set - spark_set)
extra_in_table = sorted(spark_set - excel_set)

# -------- Create Report --------
report_rows = []

for col in matched_columns:
    report_rows.append((col, "MATCHED"))

for col in missing_in_table:
    report_rows.append((col, "MISSING_IN_SPARK_TABLE"))

for col in extra_in_table:
    report_rows.append((col, "EXTRA_IN_SPARK_TABLE"))

report_df = spark.createDataFrame(
    report_rows,
    ["column_name", "status"]
)

# -------- Results --------
print("=" * 80)
print("SUMMARY")
print("=" * 80)
print(f"Excel Columns     : {len(excel_columns)}")
print(f"Spark Columns     : {len(spark_columns)}")
print(f"Matched Columns   : {len(matched_columns)}")
print(f"Missing In Table  : {len(missing_in_table)}")
print(f"Extra In Table    : {len(extra_in_table)}")

display(report_df.orderBy("status", "column_name"))

print("\nMissing In Spark Table")
print("-" * 80)
for c in missing_in_table:
    print(c)

print("\nExtra In Spark Table")
print("-" * 80)
for c in extra_in_table:
    print(c)
